headline: Fine or demerits reduced—or your fee refunded
photoHeadline: Fine reduced or ticket dismissed—or your fee refunded
payment: The service fee is paid upfront. No legal outcome is guaranteed.
condition: If a Crown offer reduces neither your original fine nor your original demerits, Fabsy refunds the service fee you paid within 30 days of receiving that offer.
photoCondition: If a Crown offer does not reduce the original fine on your photo radar or red-light camera notice, Fabsy refunds the service fee you paid within 30 days of receiving that offer. These notices have no demerits.
scope: For ticket-representation services, including Rapid Resolution, Photo Radar and the Rapid Resolution bundle. Government fines are separate.
